result.description: A fictional 27-inch desktop display designed for color grading, immersive gaming, and everyday creative work. The AuraFrame 27 uses a QD-OLED panel with 2560x1440 resolution, 240 Hz refresh rate, 0.03 ms response time, and HDR True Black support for deep contrast and vivid highlights. Connectivity includes DisplayPort 1.4, dual HDMI 2.1 inputs, USB-C with 90 W power delivery, and an integrated 4-port USB hub. The stand offers height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustment, while the chassis includes an ambient light sensor and a low-blue-light viewing mode. This model is positioned as a premium monitor rather than a storage or graphics component.
